statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed for the weekend; Stress remains high on unresolved Hormuz disruption and Friday's hawkish rate repricing.

headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Hormuz and rate risks sustain Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend. Reuters reports continuing Hormuz restrictions and sanctions pressure, while Friday's Nasdaq fell 0.52% after hawkish Fed remarks and oil finished lower. The mixed backdrop sustains high Stress but does not provide live evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure.

Closed-market conditions continue to prevent validation of failed retracements or repeated extension. Stress stays high on unresolved geopolitical and rates uncertainty.
